metadata.title: How I Stay Connected
metadata.description:
This is a video about where I get my telecom network to upload my YouTube videos. Access to network is a luxury in the quaint little villages in mountain and forest of Eastern Himalaya. 
There are very few spots in the villages where you get network and most of them are far away from home. 
Sometimes I catch myself romanticising the city life, access to everything is within your reach there, swiggy, Netflix, buying grocery and even medical emergency.
This video is about where we get out network and I upload my videos twice a week. I am someone who loves to stay in touch with family and friends. The lack of network here is definitely a difficulty 
However, I guess over a period of time you learn to adapt and love the place you are at. Changes are not easy but you have to embrace it. 
Thank you for watching everyone. 

Music Credit: Music from www.bensound.com
